identity.title: Pokémon Omega Ruby Alpha Sapphire volume 6

leadText: Volume 6 is the sixth and final volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.
plainText:
Volume 6 is the sixth and final volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version.
